scopes.company: One company, all of its units
scopes.units: Only the units this person is assigned

money.full: Every figure, including balance sheet and equity
money.operating: Revenue, cost and margin. No balance sheet, no equity, no distributions
money.unit: Only the figures for the units in scope
money.none: Counts, dates and status. No currency anywhere

roles.name: Owner / Board
roles.note: Sees every company in the group and the consolidation. The only level that sees distributions.

roles.name: Chief Executive
roles.note: Everything operational and financial. Where a group has several companies, this level still sees them all.

roles.name: Finance leadership
roles.note: Owns the close. This level and the chief executive are the two signatures a month needs.

roles.name: Operations leadership
roles.note: Revenue, cost and margin across the whole company. The balance sheet is not theirs.

roles.name: Analyst
roles.note: Reads everything finance reads and approves nothing. The level that builds the pack.

roles.name: Unit manager
roles.note: Their own units only, with full money on those: revenue, cost, margin, schedule. Nothing company-wide.

roles.name: Team lead
roles.note: Operational figures without currency: counts, hours, throughput, on-time. The level most of a workforce sits at.

roles.name: People & HR
roles.note: Headcount, payroll, open roles and turnover for the whole company. No finance pages and no balance sheet.

roles.name: Outside stakeholder
roles.note: A curated pack, not a dashboard. Signed-off periods only, which the close rules enforce rather than this list.
